title: In Search of the EKODIan
subtitle: The Hidden Biblical Portrait of God’s People
description:
What if church is not primarily a place we attend, but a people learning to embody the gospel wherever they are?

In Search of the EKODIan follows the Bible’s larger story to recover four ancient words for contemporary Christian life: Ecclesia, Koinonia, Diaspora, and Jubilee. Together they describe a people called and gathered, a community that shares burdens, a dispersed people who become bridges in unfamiliar places, and a way of life that makes room for restoration and new beginnings.

Written from a pastoral and public-theology perspective, the book moves from Sunday worship to Monday choices. Each chapter pairs a theological insight with questions for reflection and small, repeatable practices. The goal is not simply to know more, but to learn to love more faithfully in ordinary life.
author: Jeong Chan Gyun
